  PROBLEM: The freshness-sync fast path bypasses the single-issue security-pass suppression, allowing an eligible updated head to reach deterministic-skip-merge without a clean audit bound to that head.
  WHY: With SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED=true, the updated head can merge without its required audit; severity ranged from MAJOR to BLOCKER, so the highest severity is used.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1316-1323 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The freshness-sync fast path does not check PR mergeability before routing to deterministic-skip-merge, bypassing the conflict resolver.
  WHY: If the base advances with conflicting changes, deterministic-skip-merge defers and subsequent runs can repeat the fast path without ever invoking conflict resolution.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:747 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The marker-comment POST can be retried after a response failure even if GitHub accepted it, creating duplicate markers.
  WHY: Duplicate markers inflate the count used by the update cap and can allow a later merge after fewer base updates than configured; severity ranged from NIT to MAJOR, so the highest severity is used.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:736-753 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The marker body embeds the overlap-path list without a size bound, so a sufficiently large list causes GitHub to reject the comment.
  WHY: The failed POST is swallowed, leaving no marker and causing the next overlap count to under-count, which can allow updates past the configured cap.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_pr_base_fresh_for_merge | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The count-then-update-then-post sequence is not atomic, so concurrent merge paths can both post the same sync count.
  WHY: This creates duplicate markers that over-count later and trip the cap earlier, which the reviewer says fails safe.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
